title: Totem - Voodoo doll
description: This resource pack replaces the totem of undying with a voodoo doll, making it even darker and more mysterious.
body:
This resource pack replaces the totem of undying with a voodoo doll, making it even darker and more mysterious.

In the future, it will be used in a voodoo-themed mod/plugin
